title: 2026 Conditions of Participation and Attendance — official terms (insurance, six-hour finish, cancellation, DQ, health declaration)
publisher: Lewa Wildlife Conservancy and Tusk Trust Trading Limited (organisers)
claims: Participants must hold suitable insurance covering medical and travel risks, including full/comprehensive medical insurance that covers emergency medical evacuation; if organisers pay evacuation, medical, accommodation or other expenses on the participant's behalf, the participant reimburses them; only temporary medical facilities are available via AMREF and local hospitals.

A full-marathon entrant declares they can finish within six hours; if they have not crossed the half/full split point by 10:30 AM, they are not allowed to start the second loop and are recorded as a half-marathon finisher.

Category switches on race day (half to full, 10 km to half, half to 10 km) are not permitted and lead to immediate disqualification; the only exception is a marshal-ordered downgrade for medical reasons, safety concerns or official timing cutoffs, with results recorded at the permitted distance and no prize eligibility.

Cancellation refund schedule: 90+ days before the event full refund of entry fee net of bank charges; 89–60 days a 50% deduction; 59–30 days a 25% deduction; 29 days or fewer no refund; camping fees and AMREF fees are non-refundable at any point; the non-refunded entry portion is treated as a donation.
Change of runner after 5 May carries a KES 5,000 surcharge.

Health declaration: good health; no heart disease, high blood pressure, asthma, diabetes, epilepsy or condition such as pregnancy that participation may affect; trained for the event accounting for altitude, terrain and climate; wearing good-quality suitable running shoes; obeying officials and medical staff; not deviating from the route.

The organiser may refuse admission or remove a participant without compensation; the event may be cancelled, postponed, interrupted or stopped for government acts, adverse weather, civil disorder, terror, pandemic or other unforeseeable circumstances.
